summary.headline: Bonds of the Lunar Mansions
summary.text: Judicial astrology forecasts the effects of Mars, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon occupying their houses, then explains an almanac table for the Lot of Events and the six bonds (hasr) of the lunar mansions. The Indian doctrine lists the mansions in each bond and compares their mutual relationships and effects to triplicities and aspects.
